doors.why: V2: the glass gangway in the bottom rail leads down to the Observation Deck

t: DUTY ROSTER: Shift A - cages. Shift B - cages. Shift C - also cages. Complaints to Admin Vex.
SPECIMEN TANK 1F-03. Do not tap the glass. It taps back.
PROJECT RIFT: stabiliser coolant at 81%. Director Thorne wants 100% by next cycle.
PROJECT UNITY LOG, Director Thorne:
"The Ystran prophecy says whoever reunites all her children lets the Seedmother grow again."
"So we will hold all of them. One of every species, in one vault, carried through the Rift."
"Whoever holds every species controls her power to regrow life. Then no accident is ever final."
CAGE CONSOLE: the Alienmon inside presses a paw to the glass. The lock reads HELIX ADMIN ONLY.
CAGE CONSOLE: something green shuffles behind the bars. The lock is keyed to an admin card.
CONTAINMENT WING 2F. Toxin pools are for Alienmon conditioning. Do not swim.
CAGE CONSOLE: two tanks, two sleeping Alienmon. A sticky note says 'ask Bronn for the code'.
CAGE CONSOLE: status SEDATED. Someone has doodled a sad face on the screen.
REACTOR CORE: output 340% of rated. A label underneath says 'it's fine'.
ENGINEERING LOG: Rerouted core power to the Rift engine again. Lights on 2F may flicker. - B.
STAR MAP: every planet you've visited glows. One dark point beyond them all is marked RIFT.
Guard: Keep moving. Visitors aren't supposed to be on this deck.
Guard: Wait, are you a visitor? We don't get visitors. ...Carry on, I guess.
Helix grunt: I signed up for the free uniform. Nobody said it came with toxic cleanup duty.
Helix grunt: Don't tell Admin Vex you saw me napping by the planters.
Scientist: I just run the tests. Don't look at me like that.
Scientist: The medical dome up top heals anyone. Even intruders. Budget cuts hit the ID scanner.
Engineer: The power cores have been running hot all week. Engineering says it's 'within tolerance'.
Engineer: Containment wing is east. Then 2F, then Engineering, then Vex. Not that I told you.
Helix grunt: The cages? Oh, those are... wellness pods. For the Alienmon. Very relaxing pods.
Helix grunt: Toxin types love the green pools here. That's why we keep so many. Probably.
Guard: Labs are in the right dome, barracks in the left. Not that you're allowed in either.
Guard: Grunts spot you from five tiles out. Walk into their line and you WILL be battling.
Scientist: Stasis Pods work best on a weakened Alienmon. Helix just uses bigger cages.
Scientist: The Director keeps asking about Signal Shards. Why does a space station need Relay keys?
Off-duty grunt: This is my bunk. That's my bunk too. The new guy snores, so I took his.
Off-duty grunt: Lights out is at 22:00. Battles are at 22:01. Every night.
Barracks guard: Mess rule one: nobody sits in Admin Vex's chair. Rule two: see rule one.
Lab tech: Those tanks hold Alienmon from every planet you've visited. We call it 'the collection'.
Lab tech: Upstairs is Project Rift. Downstairs is everything we can't explain to HR.
Scientist: Toxin types shrug off poison, but Gravity and Psi moves hit them hard. For science.
Scientist: Please don't free the specimens. I'd have to fill out so many forms.
Senior scientist: The Rift engine needs a Singularity core. Admin Vex holds the only one aboard.
Senior scientist: Director Thorne says the Rift is a door. I've seen the numbers. It's a mouth.
Lab engineer: Don't touch the blue tank. Or the green ones. Actually, just admire from over there.
Worried scientist: They cry at night. The Alienmon, I mean. I've put in for a transfer three times.
Cage tech: Admin Bronn has the cage codes. He's been acting... odd lately. Almost sympathetic.
Reactor tech: If the core turns white, run. If it's orange, that's normal. It's always orange.
Reactor tech: Vex's arena is straight up the corridor. Heal first. She plays dirty.
Deck guard: Best view in the galaxy. Shame we only use it to watch for Relay Keepers' ships.
Helix grunt: Sometimes I come up here and wonder if we're the bad guys. Then payday comes.

notes: Helix Station (09). Docking Ring left/right edge exits moved from atlas rows 7-8 to the art's rows 6-7 (edge_rows). Healing 'bay' is the cyan-cross medical dome door on 105 (16,4); no shop. Observation Deck on the top-centre emblem gate of 105 is a judgement call (todo). Labs lift: 107 (6,8) <-> 108 (8,3). Admin Vex keeper on the throne dais of 113 (8,4), challenged from the stairs (8,5). Admin Bronn (M14 'Engineering bay') is a story NPC, not placed here.
